title_zh: 试听两张合唱录音后选定借用版本

scenario.label_zh: 比较唱片录音并选定借用版本
scenario.goal_zh: 试听两个录音的音色差别后选定借用的唱片

context_zh: 两名朋友在图书馆试听两张可借阅的合唱录音，作品与版本均为虚构。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Are these two copies of the same disc? The covers look almost identical.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: No, they're two distinct recordings of the same concert programme. One was made in a studio, the other in a church.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Can we listen to a little of each before I choose?

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: Sure. Here's the studio version first.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: I can distinguish the individual voices quite clearly. Now try the church recording.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: There's more echo in that one. Does it make the words harder to hear?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: A little. I'll borrow the studio recording because I want to learn the words.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: Then that's the blue case. The one in my hand is the church version.
